title: A Redis broker that loses a write it acknowledged loses the task silently: it never runs and stays PENDING
where: docs/getting-started/backends-and-brokers/redis.rst:268-273 (celery 768e476): RDB snapshots lose tasks published since the last one, AOF everysec up to a second
observed: 768e476 with kombu 445027e, Redis 7.4 broker with --save "" --appendonly no restarted (docker restart, injected) after apply_async() returned with the task queued, then a real worker: 3 of 3 runs the task never ran, state PENDING, nothing about it in the worker log. The classic-queue case (an unconfirmed publish lost by a kill) is the exactly-once report's measurement (3,659 of 5,100 lost without confirms, 0 with) and the Discussion draft on the confirm_publish default.
